name: OmaWrapped
author: David Gudovic
description: Your week on Omarchy as a shareable card: screen time, top apps, busiest day and hour, and git commits. Counted by the shell itself and kept on your machine.

barWidget.description: Today's screen time in the bar; click for your recap card

schema.label: Show in the bar
schema.description: 'time' shows today's screen time beside the icon; 'icon' shows the icon alone.

schema.label: Away after (seconds without input)
schema.description: Time stops counting once you have not touched the keyboard or mouse for this long.

schema.label: Count while a video or call keeps the screen awake
schema.description: On: watching a video or sitting in a call counts as screen time even without input. Off: only keyboard and mouse activity counts.

schema.label: Apps never recorded
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes (as `hyprctl clients` shows them). Time in these apps is not counted at all.

schema.label: Folders with your git repositories
schema.description: Comma-separated. Commits you authored in repositories under these folders are counted on the card.
